flora: Thallus (flat, lobed green body that looks like a fleshy tongue)
Gemma Cups (tiny splash-cups on the surface that hold green clones)
Antheridiophore (umbrella-like structures that rise up for reproduction)
Rhizoids (clear, hair-like anchors on the underside)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'slick' and 'rubbery' texture; tiny umbrella shapes add a whimsical, toy-like feel.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The flat, lobed green thallus; Top-Right: A macro of the tiny 'cups' on the surface; Bottom-Left: The little green umbrellas rising up; Bottom-Right: The underside showing white hair-like anchors.
visual_logic.ground: Wet, dark volcanic rock or saturated mud.
visual_logic.lighting: Cool, dim light with highlights reflecting off the wet, waxy surface of the plant.
